note: The thesis explicitly credits Larsen and Amarasinghe (2000) as the originators of SLP, devotes a full chapter to implementing SLP as an automatic vectorizer in LLVM, and extends it with associative chain reordering and loop shifting — the cited work's concept is the direct foundation of the contribution.
title: Automatic vectorization through superword level parellelism with associative chain re-ordering and loop shifting
